analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current price (86,755 KRW) vs SMA5 (89,453 KRW)/SMA20 (103,699 KRW)/SMA50 (105,153 KRW): Below short/mid-term trends, confirming weak positioning.
· Position relative to SMA100 (114,314 KRW)/SMA200 (99,508 KRW): Below long-term trends, maintaining weak strength.
· 52-week position (33.9%) + Approaching historical low price range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (30.7→27.4): Oversold condition persists, downward momentum maintained.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1425.6049→-2406.4506): Worsening, signaling bearish expansion.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band 85,224 KRW): Approaching lower band, entering oversold territory.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support (82,710 KRW): Above Pivot S1 (76,492 KRW), expecting support above the 20-day low (85,300 KRW).
· Swing Resistance (89,580 KRW): Approaching SMA5 (89,453 KRW), potential for short-term bounce on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Lower High formed, 5-day low 85,300 KRW): Weakening trend continues.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.74x): Low volume, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Downtrend): Consider buying on approach to swing support at 82,710 KRW; confirm resistance at 89,580 KRW on short-term bounces.
